user1.name: User1
user1.role: Person who is motivated to improve at a game but has limited experience with its mechanics, strategies, or systems and can become overwhelmed when faced with many choices, unfamiliar terminology, or complex objectives.

user2.name: User2
user2.role: Person who is organized and detail-oriented, willing to help plan strategies and optimize gameplay, but tends to overthink decisions, double-check approaches, and seek confirmation when dealing with unfamiliar game mechanics or uncertain outcomes.
